The Siebel FAQ says those Graduate College minimums are B-equivalents and the school "typically requires a higher minimum". Same faults as the other UIUC GPA proposal: US-scale floor, not the Pakistan-specific minimum, and the same FAQ says the school typically requires more. Not a genuine conflict either: the minimum (3.0/4.0) is identical and only the FAQ's loose scope wording differs. Merging it would turn the field into a Conflict with no real disagreement. 2.75 is not the worst acceptable GPA. The official CSUDH catalog MS CS page (fetched with a browser agent) says a BS in Computer Science holder with GPA above 2.44 but below 2.75 may receive conditionally classified admission. As GpaRule.min it would wrongly mark eligible Pakistani BSCS applicants (2.45-2.74) "Below minimum".

Understates the program requirement and drops a waiver. The official CSUDH catalog MS CS page requires "A minimum TOEFL score of 90" (value: 80, the university floor). The cited page also waives the test for degrees "From an institution where English is the sole language of instruction", but waiver is null, which may apply to English-medium Pakistani degrees.

Not a deadline. The page says international applications are "strongly encouraged" by July 1 and "Applications received after these dates will still be processed" (rolling admission until spaces fill). Stored as the deadline, the consultant check would call 1 Jul 2027 "the official deadline" and flag later dates as conflicts.

2.85 is not a hard floor. The same page tells applicants who "have a GPA below the minimum" to send GRE scores, so lower-GPA applicants can still apply (Pakistani applicants send the GRE anyway). As GpaRule.min (worst acceptable grade) it would wrongly mark them "Below minimum". The page also never names the 4.0 scale.

3.0 is not the worst acceptable GPA. The same page says students "below 3.0 but above 2.75 will be considered on an individual basis" (provisional admission) and that admits below 2.75 are possible on provisional status. EAS How to Apply also offers Provisional Admission. As GpaRule.min it would wrongly mark 2.75-2.99 applicants "Below minimum".
